docs.text: 这里是 CS323 编译原理（2026 秋）的实验课文档。

docs.title: 开发环境配置
docs.text:
我们教学使用的参考环境为 GNU/Linux ，发行版为 Debian 13 trixie。

如果你使用的是 GNU/Linux，不管是哪种发行版，我们相信你有足够的能力自己配好环境。

对于 Windows / macOS (arm64, Apple Silicon) 用户，我们推荐你使用 VMware 配置虚拟机，配合 VSCode / IDEA IntelliJ 的 SSH 远程开发。

此外，我们还提供了以下方案，这些方案不需要安装虚拟机，更加轻量级。但是，我们并不为这些情况提供排错与技术支持。

  1. 使用 Windows WSL
  2. 使用 macOS 的原生环境

docs.title: 使用 VMware 虚拟机
docs.text:
我们推荐使用 VMware 作为虚拟机软件，VMWare 的安装文件已经放在 https://dl.cra.moe/CS323-Compilers-2025Fall/ 下面。

Note

VMware Workstation (for Windows) 和 VMware Fusion (for macOS) 均已向个人用户免费授权，无需再使用所谓的破解版。

在安装完 VMware 后，你有两个选择：

  1. 你可以导入我们已经配置好的虚拟环境。

    Windows 用户请下载 OVF 文件，解压后将 .ovf 文件拖至 VMware 中即可。

    macOS 用户请选择包含 arm64 的压缩包，解压后将 .vmwarevm 拖入 VMware 的虚拟机列表中。你可以参照 https://yuk1i.github.io/os-next-docs/env/vm/macos/ 中的图片过程。

    Note

    预配置的 VMware 镜像中，root密码为 123456，普通用户 cs323 的密码为 123456。

  2. 你可以选择从零安装 Linux 虚拟机，请安装 Debian 13（安装镜像可从南科大镜像站上下载 https://mirrors.sustech.edu.cn/）。并安装以下软件包：

$ sudo apt update
$ sudo apt install openjdk-21-jdk llvm-19 clang-19 git make gzip flex bison

如果控制台显示 llvm-19 和 clang-19 找不到的错误，可以尝试以下命令：

wget -O - https://apt.llvm.org/llvm-snapshot.gpg.key | sudo apt-key add -
sudo add-apt-repository "deb http://apt.llvm.org/$(lsb_release -cs)/ llvm-toolchain-$(lsb_release -cs)-19 main"
sudo apt update
sudo apt install clang-19 llvm-19

docs.title: 配置开发工具
docs.text:
我们建议大家提前配置好 VS Code / IntelliJ IDEA 的 SSH 远程开发环境，或者使用 WSL 进行开发。

本节提供两种 VS Code 配置方式：

  1. 远程开发（推荐）：使用 VS Code Remote SSH 连接课程虚拟机，适合使用 VMware 的同学。
  2. 前期本地开发（临时方案）：如果暂时无法安装或启动虚拟机，可以先直接在 Windows 或 macOS 本机完成前期实验。

前期实验只需要 Git、JDK 21 和 Make，不需要先配好完整的编译器开发环境。后续实验需要 LLVM 等工具时，仍建议迁移到课程虚拟机。

docs.title: 使用 VS Code 远程开发
docs.text: 下面以 VS Code + Remote SSH 为例，带大家完成远程开发环境配置。

docs.title: 给 VS Code 安装 SSH 插件
docs.text:
按照上图完成插件安装：

  1. 点击左侧边栏的 Extensions（扩展） 按钮。
  2. 在搜索栏中输入 ssh。
  3. 找到微软官方的 Remote - SSH 插件。
  4. 点击 Install 进行安装。
  5. 安装完成后，左侧边栏中应该会出现图中 5 所示的远程连接图标。

没有看到 Remote SSH 图标？

如果安装完成后左侧边栏没有出现对应图标，可以尝试关闭 VS Code 后重新打开。

docs.title: 获取虚拟机 IP 地址
docs.text:
在配置 VS Code 之前，我们首先需要获取虚拟机的 IP 地址。

重新进入虚拟机，并使用默认账户登录：

项目 内容 用户名 cs323 密码 123456

进入虚拟机桌面后，按照下图所示的方法打开终端：

在终端中输入：

hostname -I
命令执行后，会输出当前虚拟机的 IP 地址，例如：

192.168.159.125
这个地址就是后面配置 VS Code 时需要使用的虚拟机 IP 地址。

请记录你自己的 IP 地址

每个人虚拟机的 IP 地址可能不同。

后续配置中的 HostName 必须填写你自己通过 hostname -I 查询到的 IP 地址，不要直接复制教程中的示例地址。

docs.title: 配置 VS Code Remote SSH
docs.text:
获取虚拟机 IP 地址后，重新回到 VS Code。

按照下图所示的步骤打开 SSH 配置文件：

此时 VS Code 可能会弹出多个 SSH 配置文件供你选择，通常直接选择 第一个 即可。

打开配置文件后，在其中加入：

Host cs323
    HostName 192.168.159.125
    User cs323
其中：

配置项 含义 Host 远程连接在 VS Code 中显示的名称 HostName 虚拟机的 IP 地址 User 登录虚拟机时使用的用户名

不要直接复制示例 IP

上面的：

192.168.159.125

只是示例 IP 地址。

请将 HostName 修改为你自己的虚拟机 IP 地址。

例如，如果你前面通过 hostname -I 查询到的地址为：

192.168.159.130

那么配置应该写成：

Host cs323
HostName 192.168.159.130
User cs323

docs.title: 连接虚拟机
docs.text:
保存 SSH 配置文件后，回到 VS Code 的 Remote Explorer 。

此时应该可以看到一个新的远程主机：

cs323
点击对应的连接按钮，即可连接虚拟机。

第一次连接时，VS Code 可能会要求你选择远程服务器的操作系统类型，此时请选择：

Linux
随后可能会要求输入 SSH 登录密码，默认密码为：

123456

第一次连接可能出现安全提示

第一次连接虚拟机时，SSH 可能会询问是否信任该主机。

如果看到类似：

Are you sure you want to continue connecting?
的提示，选择 Continue 即可。 连接成功后，VS Code 左下角通常会显示类似：

SSH: cs323
这表示 VS Code 已经成功连接到虚拟机。

连接成功

当 VS Code 左下角出现 SSH: cs323 后，就说明远程开发环境已经配置完成。

之后可以直接使用 VS Code 打开虚拟机中的代码目录，在虚拟机环境中进行代码编写、编译、运行和调试。

docs.title: 安装 Java 开发插件
docs.text:
由于后续实验将主要使用 Java 进行开发，因此还需要为 VS Code 安装 Java 开发相关插件。

安装方法和前面安装 Remote - SSH 插件基本相同：

  1. 首先确认当前 VS Code 已经连接到虚拟机，左下角应显示：

SSH: cs323
2. 点击 VS Code 左侧边栏的 Extensions（扩展） 按钮。 3. 在搜索栏中输入：

Extension Pack for Java
4. 找到微软提供的 Extension Pack for Java。 5. 点击 Install in SSH: cs323，将插件安装到远程虚拟机中。

必须安装在远程虚拟机中

这里需要特别注意：Java 插件必须安装在 SSH: cs323 远程环境中，而不是只安装在本地电脑中。 后续实验中的 Java 项目、JDK 以及代码运行环境都位于虚拟机中，因此 Java 的代码补全、跳转、编译、运行、调试等功能也需要在远程环境中工作。

安装时请确认按钮显示的是：

Install in SSH: cs323
而不是普通的：

Install

什么是 Extension Pack for Java？

Extension Pack for Java 是一个 Java 开发插件集合。

安装后，VS Code 会自动安装 Java 开发中常用的一系列插件，包括代码补全、代码跳转、运行、调试、测试以及 Maven 项目支持等功能。

因此大家只需要安装这个插件集合，不需要逐个安装其中的插件。

安装完成后，VS Code 就具备了在虚拟机中进行 Java 开发所需的基本功能。

docs.title: 暂时使用本机完成前期实验
docs.text:
这是虚拟机不可用时的兜底方案

不需要为此安装 WSL，也不需要提前搭建完整的 Linux 环境。只要本机能够运行 Java 和 Make，就可以先完成课程前期内容。课程推荐环境仍然是虚拟机 + Remote SSH。

docs.title: 检查基础工具
docs.text:
在 VS Code 的终端中依次执行：

git --version
java --version
make --version
能够正常显示版本号后，再继续配置编辑器。Java 推荐使用 JDK 21。

macOS 用户如果缺少 Git 或 Make，可以安装 Xcode 命令行工具：

xcode-select --install
Windows 用户可以直接安装 Git、JDK 21 和 Make。Make 可以通过 MinGW-w64 或 Chocolatey 安装；MinGW 提供的命令可能叫作 mingw32-make，后续命令中的 make 需要相应替换。

docs.title: 安装 Java 开发插件
docs.text: 打开 VS Code 左侧的 Extensions（扩展） 面板，搜索并安装微软提供的 Extension Pack for Java。安装完成且 Java 语言服务启动后，VS Code 状态栏会显示 Java 已就绪。

docs.title: 配置课程 Java 项目
docs.text:
课程项目通过 libs 目录提供 JAR 依赖。在项目根目录创建 .vscode/settings.json：

{
    "java.project.sourcePaths": ["src/main/java"],
    "java.project.referencedLibraries": [
        "libs/**/*.jar"
    ],
    "java.project.outputPath": "bin"
}

再在命令面板输入并执行：Debug: Add Configuration，选择 Java，生成 .vscode/launch.json，替换为以下配置：

{
    "version": "0.2.0",
    "configurations": [
        {
            "type": "java",
            "name": "Launch Current File",
            "request": "launch",
            "mainClass": "${file}",
            "classPaths": [
                "libs/*",
                "bin"
            ]
        }
    ]
}
  • ${file}：内置变量，自动运行 当前编辑器打开的、带 main 方法的 Java 文件 ，无需为每个文件单独配置
  • classPaths：运行时的类路径，包含依赖 Jar 包和编译输出目录

这里可以直接创建这两个文件，在项目的根目录：

保存后，打开命令面板并执行 Developer: Reload Window。在 VS Code 的 JAVA PROJECTS 视图中看到 Referenced Libraries，说明 JAR 已被识别。

Java 扩展可以直接运行当前打开的、包含 main 方法的类。只有需要固定主类、参数或环境变量时，才需要通过 Run and Debug: Add Configuration 创建 .vscode/launch.json。

docs.title: 使用 Makefile
docs.text:
执行 Make 命令前，确认终端位于包含 Makefile 的项目根目录：

# 清理旧的生成文件
make clean

# 执行 Makefile 的默认目标
make
具体可用目标以当前项目的 Makefile 为准。如果希望在 VS Code 中查看和执行 Makefile 目标，可以安装微软提供的 Makefile Tools 扩展。

docs.title: Windows 版本 Makefile
docs.text:
在 Windows 中使用 Make 工具时候需要将项目根目录的 Makefile 改为下面的版本：

ANTLR_JAR  := libs/antlr-4.13.2-complete.jar
OUTPUT_DIR := src/main/java/generated

GRAMMARS := $(basename $(wildcard *.g4))

.DEFAULT_GOAL := all
.PHONY: all clean

all: $(GRAMMARS)

$(GRAMMARS): %: $(OUTPUT_DIR)/%Parser.java

$(OUTPUT_DIR)/%Parser.java: %.g4
    @if not exist "$(OUTPUT_DIR)" mkdir "$(OUTPUT_DIR)"
    @echo Building $(basename $<)
    java -jar $(ANTLR_JAR) -visitor -o $(OUTPUT_DIR)/$(basename $<) -package generated.$(basename $<) $<

clean:
    @if exist "$(OUTPUT_DIR)" rmdir /S /Q "$(OUTPUT_DIR)"

命令行必须以 Tab 开头

if、echo、java 和 rmdir 四行前面必须是 Tab，不能用空格代替。这里使用 .DEFAULT_GOAL := all 指定默认目标；原来的 .DEFAULT = all 并不是 GNU Make 设置默认目标的正确写法。 该版本不包含 Maven 的 jar 目标。编译与清理命令分别为：

mingw32-make
mingw32-make clean
如果安装后命令名就是 make，则直接使用 make 和 make clean。

docs.title: Windows WSL 设置
docs.text:
我们不对 WSL 环境下遇到的问题提供帮助。 如果你遇到了一些问题，请考虑自行解决或切换为 VMware 虚拟环境。

推荐环境为 WSL2 + Debian 13 (trixie)。如果你已经有一份 Ubuntu 的 WSL，理论上直接用 Ubuntu 的不会有任何问题。

指定安装 Debian:

wsl --install Debian

如何安装 WSL2 请参考 微软教程，我们也向你推荐 WSL 的 官方配置手册

然后，使用包管理器 apt 安装依赖：

$ sudo apt update
$ sudo apt install openjdk-21-jdk llvm-19 clang-19 git make gzip flex bison

如果控制台显示 llvm-19 和 clang-19 找不到的错误，可以尝试以下命令：

wget -O - https://apt.llvm.org/llvm-snapshot.gpg.key | sudo apt-key add -
sudo add-apt-repository "deb http://apt.llvm.org/$(lsb_release -cs)/ llvm-toolchain-$(lsb_release -cs)-19 main"
sudo apt update
sudo apt install clang-19 llvm-19

docs.title: RoadMap
docs.text:
Lab 课大致安排：

  • 有多个 Projects，最终任务是写一个类C语言的编译器，我们会将这个大任务拆成多个 Projects，并提供 Hints。
  • 每个 Project 之间是串联在一起的。即你在上个 Project 写的代码会在下一个 Project 中用到。

所以，请保持你代码的良好结构。 - 每个 Project 都具有相同的结构：

  • 我们提供的 Framework
  • 你需要自行完成的 Implementation
  • 每个 Project 都将由自动评测脚本进行评测，所以千万不要改 Framework 的接口！

docs.title: 搭建环境
docs.text: 参考 环境配置

docs.title: 什么是 ANTLR
docs.text:
ChatGPT said:

ANTLR（ANother Tool for Language Recognition）是一个功能强大的 语法解析器生成工具，常用于构建编译器、解释器、DSL（领域特定语言）、代码分析工具等。它的主要作用是将 文法规则 转换成可以在目标语言（如 Java、C#, Python, JavaScript 等）中运行的 词法分析器（Lexer） 和 语法分析器（Parser）。

docs.title: 什么是文法规则
docs.text:
具体而言，我们可以可以把 文法规则 想象成 语言的“说明书” 或 造句的规矩。

在自然语言里，我们有语法，比如：

  • 主语 + 谓语 + 宾语
  • “我 吃 苹果” ✅

同样，编程语言 或 数据格式 也有自己的规则，用来规定哪些符号组合是合法的。

抽象的来说，文法规则通常用来描述：

  • 词汇层次：最小的语法单元，比如数字、单词、符号。
  • 结构层次：这些词汇如何组合成更大的结构，比如“表达式”“语句”“程序”。

换句话说：

  • 文法规则是一组形式化的 生产规则，规定了“从哪些符号出发，能一步步生成一个完整的合法句子”。
  • 这些规则通常用 递归 方式定义，可以无限扩展。

docs.title: ANTLR 配置
docs.text:
首先，按照环境配置选择并完成一种开发方式。推荐使用 VS Code 连接课程虚拟机；如果虚拟机暂时不可用，也可以先在 Windows 或 macOS 本机配置 Java 和 Make，完成前期实验。

如果使用远程开发，连接成功后 VS Code 左下角会显示类似下面的内容：

SSH: cs323

出现 SSH: cs323 即表示当前 VS Code 已经成功连接到远程虚拟机。

接下来，在 VS Code 中点击 Clone Repository，并输入课程项目仓库地址：

https://github.com/sqlab-sustech/CS323-Compilers-2026F-Projects.git

按照 VS Code 的提示选择仓库保存位置并完成克隆后，打开该项目目录。

接下来打开 VS Code 的终端。可以通过菜单打开，也可以直接使用快捷键：

Ctrl + `

确认终端位于所选开发环境

使用 Remote SSH 时，终端应该位于虚拟机中，并且 VS Code 左下角仍显示 SSH: cs323。

暂时使用 Windows 或 macOS 本机时，后续命令应始终在本机的项目目录中执行。

接着，在终端中输入：

git checkout lab1
该命令会将当前项目切换到本次实验使用的 lab1 分支。

切换成功后，可以在 VS Code 左侧的文件浏览栏中看到类似下面的项目目录：

准备完成

如果左侧文件浏览栏已经正常显示项目目录，并且当前分支为 lab1，说明本次实验所需的代码已经准备完成。项目根目录包含 Makefile、ANTLR 的 .g4 文件、源码目录和测试用例目录；实际目录结构以当前 lab1 分支为准。

docs.title: 配置 VS Code 的 JAR 依赖
docs.text:
课程项目通过 libs 目录提供 ANTLR 的 JAR 包。为了让 VS Code 正确识别源码和依赖，按 Ctrl+Shift+P（Windows）或 Cmd+Shift+P（macOS）打开命令面板，然后选择 Preferences: Open Workspace Settings (JSON)。

在项目根目录的 .vscode/settings.json 中加入：

{
    "java.project.sourcePaths": ["src/main/java"],
    "java.project.referencedLibraries": [
        "libs/**/*.jar"
    ],
    "java.project.outputPath": "bin"
}

再在命令面板输入并执行：Debug: Add Configuration，选择 Java，生成 .vscode/launch.json，替换为以下配置：

{
    "version": "0.2.0",
    "configurations": [
        {
            "type": "java",
            "name": "Launch Current File",
            "request": "launch",
            "mainClass": "${file}",
            "classPaths": [
                "libs/*",
                "bin"
            ]
        }
    ]
}
  • ${file}：内置变量，自动运行 当前编辑器打开的、带 main 方法的 Java 文件 ，无需为每个文件单独配置
  • classPaths：运行时的类路径，包含依赖 Jar 包和编译输出目录

这里可以直接创建这两个文件，在项目的根目录：

保存配置后，再次打开命令面板并执行 Developer: Reload Window。

窗口重新加载后，如果 JAVA PROJECTS 视图的 Referenced Libraries 中能够看到 libs 下的 JAR 包，说明依赖配置已经生效。

docs.title: 使用 Makefile 编译 ANTLR 语法文件
docs.text:
我们之前说，ANTLR 是一套 语法解析器生成工具，它可以针对某个给定的语法文件（形式语言学的上下文中，语法和文法绝大多数情况下指的是同一回事，两个术语可以互换使用），生成一些可以处理该语法的代码。

项目根目录中有一个 Calc1.g4 文件，它是一个 ANTLR 的语法文件。确认终端位于 Makefile 所在的项目根目录，然后执行：

make

执行后，我们可以注意到在 src/main/java 下面多了 generated.Calc1 这个包，里面有若干 .java 文件。这些代码就是 ANTLR 工具针对 Calc1.g4 这个语法生成的代码。

在本机终端中执行时，可以看到类似下面的输出：

再执行：

make clean

我们会发现 generated/ 目录被删除了。Makefile 的目标可能随实验分支变化；可以直接查看当前分支中的 Makefile，或使用 VS Code 的 Makefile Tools 扩展查看可用目标。

docs.title: 调用 ANTLR 生成的解析器
docs.text:
将 Main.java 覆盖为如下内容：

import generated.Calc1.Calc1Lexer;
import generated.Calc1.Calc1Parser;
import org.antlr.v4.runtime.*;
import org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // 把要解析的字符串喂给 ANTLR
        CharStream input = CharStreams.fromString("1 + 2");
        // 词法分析器
        Calc1Lexer lexer = new Calc1Lexer(input);
        // Token 流
        CommonTokenStream tokens = new CommonTokenStream(lexer);
        // 语法分析器
        Calc1Parser parser = new Calc1Parser(tokens);
        // 从规则 'expression' 开始解析
        ParseTree tree = parser.expr();
        // 把树打印出来看看
        System.out.println(tree.toStringTree(parser));
    }
}
然后，运行该 Main 类(如果你按照环境配置需求安装好了VSCode的 Java Extension Pack 插件，你应该能在右上角看到一个小三角显示 Extension Pack for Java)，Console 会输出：

line 1:5 no viable alternative at input '<EOF>'
(expr (expr (factor 1)) + (expr (factor 2)))
这就表示 ANTLR 构建的解析器成功把 1 + 2 拆成了一棵语法树，至于第一句报错是什么意思，我们会在后续 Lexer 中讲解。

暂时看不懂树长什么样没关系，后面我们会慢慢讲到它背后的含义。

docs.title: Preface
docs.text: This is the lab documentation for CS323 Compilers (Fall 2026).

docs.title: Development Environment Setup
docs.text:
The reference environment used for this course is GNU/Linux, specifically Debian 13 trixie.

If you use GNU/Linux, regardless of the distribution, we assume you are able to configure the environment yourself.

For Windows and macOS (arm64, Apple Silicon) users, we recommend using VMware to set up a virtual machine, together with SSH remote development in VS Code or IntelliJ IDEA.

We also provide the following lighter-weight options that do not require a virtual machine. However, we do not provide troubleshooting or technical support for them.

  1. Windows WSL
  2. Native macOS environment

docs.title: Using a VMware Virtual Machine
docs.text:
We recommend VMware as the virtualization software. VMware installers are available at https://dl.cra.moe/CS323-Compilers-2025Fall/.

Note

VMware Workstation (for Windows) and VMware Fusion (for macOS) are free for personal use. You do not need to use unofficial cracked versions.

After installing VMware, you have two options:

  1. Import our preconfigured virtual environment.

    Windows users should download the OVF archive, extract it, and drag the .ovf file into VMware.

    macOS users should select the archive that includes arm64, extract it, and drag the .vmwarevm file into VMware's virtual machine list. You may refer to the screenshots at https://yuk1i.github.io/os-next-docs/env/vm/macos/.

    Note

    In the preconfigured VMware image, the password for root is 123456, and the password for the regular user cs323 is also 123456.

  2. Install a Linux virtual machine from scratch. Please install Debian 13; installation images are available from the SUSTech mirror at https://mirrors.sustech.edu.cn/. Then install the following packages: 

    $ sudo apt update
$ sudo apt install openjdk-21-jdk llvm-19 clang-19 git make gzip flex bison
    If the console reports that llvm-19 and clang-19 cannot be found, try the following commands:

wget -O - https://apt.llvm.org/llvm-snapshot.gpg.key | sudo apt-key add -
sudo add-apt-repository "deb http://apt.llvm.org/$(lsb_release -cs)/ llvm-toolchain-$(lsb_release -cs)-19 main"
sudo apt update
sudo apt install clang-19 llvm-19

docs.title: Setting Up Development Tools
docs.text:
We recommend setting up SSH remote development with VS Code or IntelliJ IDEA in advance, or developing with WSL.

This section provides two ways to configure VS Code:

  1. Remote development (recommended): connect to the course virtual machine with VS Code Remote SSH. This is suitable for students using VMware.
  2. Local development for the early labs (temporary option): if you cannot install or start the virtual machine yet, you can complete the early labs directly on Windows or macOS.

The early labs only require Git, JDK 21, and Make. You do not need to prepare the complete compiler toolchain first. When later labs require tools such as LLVM, moving to the course virtual machine is still recommended.

docs.title: Remote Development with VS Code
docs.text: The following instructions use VS Code + Remote SSH to configure a remote development environment.

docs.title: Install the SSH Extension for VS Code
docs.text:
Follow the screenshot above to install the extension:

  1. Click Extensions in the left sidebar.
  2. Enter ssh in the search bar.
  3. Find Microsoft's official Remote - SSH extension.
  4. Click Install.
  5. After installation, the remote connection icon marked 5 in the screenshot should appear in the left sidebar.

Cannot Find the Remote SSH Icon?

If the icon does not appear in the left sidebar after installation, try closing and reopening VS Code.

docs.title: Obtain the Virtual Machine IP Address
docs.text:
Before configuring VS Code, you first need the IP address of your virtual machine.

Open the virtual machine again and log in with the default account:

Item Value Username cs323 Password 123456

After entering the virtual machine desktop, open a terminal as shown below:

Enter the following command in the terminal:

hostname -I
The command prints the IP address of the current virtual machine, for example:

192.168.159.125
You will use this address when configuring VS Code later.

Record Your Own IP Address

Every virtual machine may have a different IP address.

The HostName in the later configuration must be the address returned by your own hostname -I command. Do not copy the example address directly.

docs.title: Configure VS Code Remote SSH
docs.text:
After obtaining the virtual machine IP address, return to VS Code.

Open the SSH configuration file as shown below:

VS Code may offer several SSH configuration files. Usually, selecting the first one is sufficient.

Add the following to the configuration file:

Host cs323
    HostName 192.168.159.125
    User cs323
Setting Meaning Host The name shown for the remote connection in VS Code HostName The IP address of the virtual machine User The username used to log in to the virtual machine

Do Not Copy the Example IP Address

The address below:

192.168.159.125

is only an example.

Replace HostName with your own virtual machine IP address.

For example, if hostname -I returned:

192.168.159.130

your configuration should be:

Host cs323
HostName 192.168.159.130
User cs323

docs.title: Connect to the Virtual Machine
docs.text:
After saving the SSH configuration file, return to Remote Explorer in VS Code.

You should now see a new remote host:

cs323
Click its connection button to connect to the virtual machine.

On the first connection, VS Code may ask you to choose the remote server's operating system. Select:

Linux
It may then ask for the SSH login password. The default password is:

123456

A Security Prompt May Appear on the First Connection

When connecting to the virtual machine for the first time, SSH may ask whether you trust the host.

If you see a prompt like:

Are you sure you want to continue connecting?

choose Continue. After a successful connection, VS Code usually shows the following in its bottom-left corner:

SSH: cs323
This means VS Code has successfully connected to the virtual machine.

Connection Successful

When SSH: cs323 appears in the bottom-left corner of VS Code, the remote development environment is ready.

You can then open the code directory in the virtual machine with VS Code, and write, compile, run, and debug code in the virtual machine environment.

docs.title: Install the Java Development Extension
docs.text:
Later labs will primarily use Java, so you also need to install Java development extensions for VS Code.

The procedure is largely the same as installing Remote - SSH:

  1. First confirm that VS Code is connected to the virtual machine. The bottom-left corner should display:

SSH: cs323
2. Click Extensions in the VS Code left sidebar. 3. Enter the following in the search bar:

Extension Pack for Java
4. Find Microsoft's Extension Pack for Java. 5. Click Install in SSH: cs323 to install the extension on the remote virtual machine.

The Extension Must Be Installed in the Remote Virtual Machine

The Java extensions must be installed in the SSH: cs323 remote environment, not only on your local computer. Java projects, the JDK, and the runtime environment for later labs are all located in the virtual machine. Therefore, code completion, navigation, compilation, execution, and debugging must also run in the remote environment.

When installing, make sure the button says:

Install in SSH: cs323
rather than the standard:

Install

What Is Extension Pack for Java?

Extension Pack for Java is a collection of Java development extensions.

After installation, VS Code automatically installs a set of commonly used Java development extensions, including support for code completion, navigation, running, debugging, testing, and Maven projects.

Therefore, you only need to install this extension pack instead of installing each included extension separately.

Once installed, VS Code has the basic features required for Java development in the virtual machine.

docs.title: Temporarily Complete the Early Labs Locally
docs.text:
A fallback when the virtual machine is unavailable

You do not need to install WSL or prepare a complete Linux environment for this option. If Java and Make run locally, you can start the early course work. The recommended environment remains a virtual machine with Remote SSH.

docs.title: Check the Required Tools
docs.text:
Run the following commands in the VS Code terminal:

git --version
java --version
make --version
Continue configuring the editor after all three commands print version information. JDK 21 is recommended for Java.

If Git or Make is missing on macOS, install the Xcode command-line tools:

xcode-select --install
Windows users can install Git, JDK 21, and Make directly. Make can be installed through MinGW-w64 or Chocolatey. The MinGW executable may be named mingw32-make; if so, replace make in later commands with that name.

docs.title: Install the Java Development Extensions
docs.text: Open Extensions in the VS Code left sidebar, then find and install Microsoft's Extension Pack for Java. After installation and once the Java language service has started, the VS Code status bar will indicate that Java is ready.

docs.title: Configure the Course Java Project
docs.text:
The course project provides its JAR dependencies in the libs directory. Create .vscode/settings.json in the project root:

{
    "java.project.sourcePaths": ["src/main/java"],
    "java.project.referencedLibraries": [
        "libs/**/*.jar"
    ],
    "java.project.outputPath": "bin"
}

Then, open the Command Palette again, enter and run Debug: Add Configuration, select Java, and generate .vscode/launch.json. Replace its contents with the following configuration:

{
    "version": "0.2.0",
    "configurations": [
        {
            "type": "java",
            "name": "Launch Current File",
            "request": "launch",
            "mainClass": "${file}",
            "classPaths": [
                "libs/*",
                "bin"
            ]
        }
    ]
}

  • ${file}: A built-in variable that automatically runs the Java file currently open in the editor that contains a main method, so you do not need to create a separate configuration for each file.

  • classPaths: The runtime classpath, including the dependency JAR files and the compilation output directory.

You can also create these two files directly. They should be located in the root directory of the project:

Save the file, open the command palette, and run Developer: Reload Window. If Referenced Libraries appears in the VS Code JAVA PROJECTS view, the JAR files have been detected.

The Java extensions can directly run the currently open class if it contains a main method. Create .vscode/launch.json through Run and Debug: Add Configuration only when you need to fix the main class, arguments, or environment variables.

docs.title: Use the Makefile
docs.text:
Before running Make, confirm that the terminal is in the project root containing the Makefile:

# Remove old generated files
make clean

# Run the default Makefile target
make
The available targets are defined by the current project's Makefile. You can install Microsoft's Makefile Tools extension to view and run Makefile targets in VS Code.

docs.title: Makefile for Windows
docs.text:
Forward-slash paths such as libs/... and src/... in the original Makefile can remain unchanged: GNU Make and Java recognize them on Windows. The Linux commands mkdir -p and rm -rf are the parts that must be replaced.

When using GNU Make from Windows cmd or PowerShell, replace the Makefile in the project root with this version:

ANTLR_JAR  := libs/antlr-4.13.2-complete.jar
OUTPUT_DIR := src/main/java/generated

GRAMMARS := $(basename $(wildcard *.g4))

.DEFAULT_GOAL := all
.PHONY: all clean

all: $(GRAMMARS)

$(GRAMMARS): %: $(OUTPUT_DIR)/%Parser.java

$(OUTPUT_DIR)/%Parser.java: %.g4
    @if not exist "$(OUTPUT_DIR)" mkdir "$(OUTPUT_DIR)"
    @echo Building $(basename $<)
    java -jar $(ANTLR_JAR) -visitor -o $(OUTPUT_DIR)/$(basename $<) -package generated.$(basename $<) $<

clean:
    @if exist "$(OUTPUT_DIR)" rmdir /S /Q "$(OUTPUT_DIR)"

Recipe lines must start with a Tab

The four lines starting with if, echo, java, and rmdir must begin with a Tab, not spaces. This version uses .DEFAULT_GOAL := all to select the default target; the original .DEFAULT = all does not correctly set GNU Make's default goal. This version does not include the Maven-based jar target. Build and clean the project with:

mingw32-make
mingw32-make clean
If the installed executable is named make, use make and make clean instead.

docs.text:
We do not provide support for issues encountered in a WSL environment. If you run into problems, please resolve them independently or switch to the VMware virtual environment.

The recommended environment is WSL2 with Debian 13 (trixie). If you already have an Ubuntu WSL installation, it should work without issues in principle.

Then use the apt package manager to install the dependencies:

If the console reports that llvm-19 and clang-19 cannot be found, try the following commands:

wget -O - https://apt.llvm.org/llvm-snapshot.gpg.key | sudo apt-key add -

docs.title: Roadmap
docs.text:
Here is the rough structure of the lab sessions:

  • There are multiple Projects within this course. The final goal is to build a compiler for a C-like programming language. We will split this large task into several Projects and provide hints along the way.
  • The Projects are connected in sequence. In other words, the code you write in one Project will be used in the next one.

So please keep your code well organized. - Every Project has the same structure:

  • A Framework provided by us
  • An Implementation that you need to complete on your own
  • Every Project will be graded by an automated evaluation script, so do not change the interfaces of the Framework.

docs.title: Setting Up the Environment
docs.text: Refer to Environment Setup.

docs.title: What Is ANTLR
docs.text:
ChatGPT said:

ANTLR (ANother Tool for Language Recognition) is a powerful parser generator commonly used to build compilers, interpreters, DSLs (domain-specific languages), code analysis tools, and more. Its main purpose is to transform grammar rules into a lexer and a parser that can run in a target language such as Java, C#, Python, or JavaScript.

docs.title: What Are Grammar Rules
docs.text:
More concretely, we can think of grammar rules as the "instruction manual" of a language, or the rules for forming valid sentences.

In natural language, for example, we have grammar such as:

  • subject + predicate + object
  • "I eat apples" ✅

Similarly, programming languages and data formats also have their own rules, which specify what combinations of symbols are valid.

Conceptually, grammar rules usually describe:

  • Lexical level: the smallest syntax units, such as numbers, words, and symbols.
  • Structural level: how these units combine into larger structures such as expressions, statements, and programs.

In other words:

  • Grammar rules are a set of formal production rules that define how a complete valid sentence can be generated step by step from symbols.
  • These rules are often defined recursively and can be expanded indefinitely.

docs.title: ANTLR Setup
docs.text:
First, follow Environment Setup and choose one development method. Connecting VS Code to the course virtual machine is recommended. If the virtual machine is temporarily unavailable, you can configure Java and Make directly on Windows or macOS and complete the early labs locally.

If you use remote development, the lower-left corner of VS Code should display something like this after connecting:

SSH: cs323

If you see SSH: cs323, it means that VS Code is successfully connected to the remote virtual machine.

Next, click Clone Repository in VS Code and enter the course project repository URL:

https://github.com/sqlab-sustech/CS323-Compilers-2026F-Projects.git

Follow the prompts in VS Code to choose a location for the repository and finish cloning it, then open the project directory.

Next, open the terminal in VS Code. You can do this from the menu, or by using the shortcut:

Ctrl + `

Make sure the terminal is in your chosen development environment

When using Remote SSH, the terminal should be running on the virtual machine, and the lower-left corner of VS Code should still show SSH: cs323.

When temporarily using Windows or macOS directly, run all subsequent commands from the local project directory.

Then, enter the following command in the terminal:

git checkout lab1
This command switches the current project to the lab1 branch used for this lab.

After switching successfully, you should be able to see a project directory similar to the following in the VS Code file explorer:

Ready

If the project directory is displayed correctly in the file explorer and the current branch is lab1, then the code required for this lab is ready. The project root contains a Makefile, ANTLR .g4 files, a source directory, and a test-case directory; always treat the current lab1 branch as the source of truth for the exact structure.

docs.title: Configure the JAR Dependencies in VS Code
docs.text:
The course project provides the ANTLR JAR file in the libs directory. To let VS Code recognize the source code and dependencies, press Ctrl+Shift+P on Windows or Cmd+Shift+P on macOS to open the command palette, then select Preferences: Open Workspace Settings (JSON).

Add the following configuration to .vscode/settings.json in the project root:

{
    "java.project.sourcePaths": ["src/main/java"],
    "java.project.referencedLibraries": [
        "libs/**/*.jar"
    ],
    "java.project.outputPath": "bin"
}

Then, open the Command Palette again, enter and run Debug: Add Configuration, select Java, and generate .vscode/launch.json. Replace its contents with the following configuration:

{
    "version": "0.2.0",
    "configurations": [
        {
            "type": "java",
            "name": "Launch Current File",
            "request": "launch",
            "mainClass": "${file}",
            "classPaths": [
                "libs/*",
                "bin"
            ]
        }
    ]
}

  • ${file}: A built-in variable that automatically runs the Java file currently open in the editor that contains a main method, so you do not need to create a separate configuration for each file.

  • classPaths: The runtime classpath, including the dependency JAR files and the compilation output directory.

You can also create these two files directly. They should be located in the root directory of the project:

Save the configuration, open the command palette again, and run Developer: Reload Window.

After the window reloads, check Referenced Libraries in the JAVA PROJECTS view. If it contains the JAR file from libs, the dependency configuration is active.

docs.title: Using the Makefile to Compile ANTLR Grammar Files
docs.text:
As mentioned earlier, ANTLR is a parser generator. Given a grammar file, it can generate code that processes that grammar.

There is a file named Calc1.g4 in the project root directory. It is an ANTLR grammar file. Make sure the terminal is in the project root containing the Makefile, then run:

make

Afterward, you will notice that a new package named generated.Calc1 appears under src/main/java, containing several .java files. These are the files generated by ANTLR from the grammar Calc1.g4.

When running the command in a local terminal, you should see output similar to the following:

Then run:

make clean

You will find that the generated/ directory is removed. Makefile targets may vary between lab branches; inspect the Makefile in the current branch or use the VS Code Makefile Tools extension to see the available targets.

docs.title: Calling the Parser Generated by ANTLR
docs.text:
Replace Main.java with the following content:

import generated.Calc1.Calc1Lexer;
import generated.Calc1.Calc1Parser;
import org.antlr.v4.runtime.*;
import org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Feed the string to be parsed into ANTLR
        CharStream input = CharStreams.fromString("1 + 2");
        // Lexer
        Calc1Lexer lexer = new Calc1Lexer(input);
        // Token stream
        CommonTokenStream tokens = new CommonTokenStream(lexer);
        // Parser
        Calc1Parser parser = new Calc1Parser(tokens);
        // Start parsing from the rule 'expression'
        ParseTree tree = parser.expr();
        // Print the parse tree
        System.out.println(tree.toStringTree(parser));
    }
}
Then run the Main class. If you installed the Java Extension Pack in VS Code as required in the environment setup, you should see a small triangle in the upper-right corner labeled Extension Pack for Java. The console will output:

line 1:5 no viable alternative at input '<EOF>'
(expr (expr (factor 1)) + (expr (factor 2)))
This means the parser built by ANTLR successfully parsed 1 + 2 into a syntax tree. As for the first error message, we will explain it later in the Lexer section.

It is completely fine if the tree does not make much sense yet. We will gradually explain what it means in the following labs.
